mission_03: Custom transformers extend sklearn pipeline functionality with domain-specific preprocessing logic. By inheriting from BaseEstimator and TransformerMixin, your custom classes gain compatibility with all sklearn tools including Pipeline, GridSearchCV, and cross-validation. The fit method learns any parameters needed for transformation (like column statistics), while transform applies the actual transformation. Custom transformers enable you to encapsulate complex preprocessing logic into reusable, testable components that integrate seamlessly with the sklearn ecosystem. Common use cases include feature selection, domain-specific transformations, text processing, and feature engineering. Well-designed custom transformers make pipelines more readable, maintainable, and portable across projects.
